ABSTRACT AND PROJECT SCOPE
textPreview: ABSTRACT AND PROJECT SCOPE

text: One control hub for multiple execution domains
textPreview: One control hub for multiple execution domains

text:
MasterHub accepts browser controls, arrow keys, API commands and classified mental commands from EMOTIV Cortex.
The Flask application maintains context, resolves command mappings and dispatches actions through dedicated handlers.
The current project connects desktop applications, IoT relay devices, mobility hardware and desktop or mobile media workflows.
The original IoT work remains part of the wider SynaptiMesh project.

MOBILE MQTT AND ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
textPreview: MOBILE MQTT AND ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

text: The phone uses an independent MQTT service
textPreview: The phone uses an independent MQTT service

text:
Separate topics carry commands, status, heartbeat, media, acknowledgements and errors.
Dispatch requires a fresh phone heartbeat and remote control enabled on the phone.
Each command carries a unique ID, issue time and expiry time.
The service tracks PENDING, EXECUTED, FAILED, REJECTED, UNCONFIRMED and TIMEOUT results.
Retained online messages cannot establish fresh liveness.

LIVE BCI TEMPORAL CONTROLLER
textPreview: LIVE BCI TEMPORAL CONTROLLER

text: One frame captures one single or ordered pair
textPreview: One frame captures one single or ordered pair

text:
A neutral sample rearms control. A qualifying active sample starts the frame.
The default detector-power threshold is 0.20, subject to configuration.
A distinct second gesture joins the first only when that pair exists in the current mode.
Repeated packets of the same held gesture do not create repeated commands.
Singles and valid pairs execute at the original deadline when a new prediction arrives.
